_comment: Dexaflow-owned overlay merged over the GENERATED catalog.json at load (see catalog.go). These are dbt-auth fields that Airflow's provider introspection does not emit — either leoflow-invented selectors (BigQuery `method`) or fields Airflow's form omits (Snowflake key passphrase, the whole Databricks form). Each field mirrors the FlexibleForm shape the SPA renders; `description` becomes the field's help text. Hand-curated on purpose: unlike catalog.json, this file is safe to edit. Keep field names in sync with runtime/python/leoflow_runtime/dbt.py.

private_key_passphrase.description: Passphrase for an encrypted key-pair private key. Leave blank for an unencrypted key or password auth.

method.description: dbt auth method. Set to `oauth` for keyless auth via Application Default Credentials / GKE Workload Identity (no key file shipped). Leave blank to authenticate with keyfile_dict.

password.title: Access token (PAT)
password.placeholder: dapi… — leave blank when using OAuth M2M

http_path.description: SQL warehouse or cluster HTTP path, e.g. /sql/1.0/warehouses/abc123.

catalog.description: Unity Catalog catalog to run dbt against (optional).

auth_type.description: Set to `oauth` for service-principal OAuth M2M (Databricks' recommended automation auth). Leave blank to authenticate with the access token above.

client_id.description: Service-principal client ID (OAuth M2M). Required with client_secret when auth_type is oauth.
